async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the keycloak/keycloak project using the knowledge base function
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, "keycloak/keycloak")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Click on the issues link for the project
    # Look for a link with role "link" and name "Issues" in the project page
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Issues", exact=True)
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Apply filter for labels related to flaky-test
    # Try to find a textbox for filtering by label
    filter_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Filter by label")
    if await filter_input.count() > 0:
        await filter_input.fill("flaky-test")
        await filter_input.press("Enter")
    else:
        # Alternative: look for a button to open label filter
        label_filter_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Label")
        if await label_filter_button.count() > 0:
            await label_filter_button.click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            flaky_label = page.get_by_role("option", name="flaky-test")
            if await flaky_label.count() > 0:
                await flaky_label.click()
            else:
                label_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search labels")
                if await label_input.count() > 0:
                    await label_input.fill("flaky-test")
                    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
                    first_option = page.get_by_role("option").first
                    await first_option.click()
    
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    
    # Step 4: Retrieve and output the list of issues using accessibility tree selectors
    # Look for list items or articles that represent issues
    issues_items = page.get_by_role("listitem").or_(page.get_by_role("article"))
    count = await issues_items.count()
    if count > 0:
        issues_text = []
        for i in range(count):
            issue = issues_items.nth(i)
            text = await issue.text_content()
            issues_text.append(text)
        result = "\n".join(issues_text)
    else:
        result = "No issues found with labels related to flaky-test."
    
    print(result)
    return result
